description: Localized dialogue for short/sub stories (STDM_00xxxxx_* message ids). Scripts named STDM_SS_* have their ids rewritten to this namespace, and their lines are displayed by the same story-demo rich-text path as main demos.

ID.simple: Short-story message id (row key), e.g. STDM_0000101_0010.
ID.technical: FName ID of FGameDataTableRow_GameText. GameScript_GetStoryTextId detects 'STDM_SS_' in the script name, replaces that prefix with 'STDM_00' and appends '01' to form the search key; FindTextIdsContaining returns all GameText rows whose ID contains it and the message ids are sorted into FGameScriptContext::MessageIdList. Short-story scripts are identified by GameScript_IsSubStoryScript (same substring test), which selects ShortStoryVoiceDataTable for the voice join. The text table is loaded as ShortStoryDemoTextDataTable_<Language> in slot 9 of the 14-table array.

Text.technical: FString row text (+0x10), resolved by GetGameTextById and passed through FormatText before UGameWidgetMarkupParseProcessor::Parse in UGameStoryDemoMultiRichTextBlockWidget::DisplayMessage. Missing rows render as empty text. The En export has 627 nonempty lines with no GLO/DYN markup; the shared formatter would still handle such tags if present. Message ids also drive timed voice playback via the ShortStoryVoice -> Voice table join.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_GameText with 11 exported language variants (627 identical row ids each, no empty strings in the companion export). Slot 9 in GameTextManager::Tick; Config/DefaultGame.ini:35-45 cooks one variant per language chunk.

ShortStory rows (ShortStoryDataTable) carry Id_Script = STDM_SS_*, Id_ShortStoryCharacter and Id_StoryText_Title. The title id (e.g. STR_STDM_SS_001 in the companion export) is a StoryTextDataTable entry, not a row in this dialogue table; the list widget sets that id directly on its button text (GameStoryCharaRelateShortStoryListItemWidget.cpp:100).

As with the other story text groups, message discovery uses substring matching over all 14 GameText tables, not a table-specific query. The STDM_00 namespace is a naming convention produced by the script-id rewrite; a colliding id in an earlier table would win.

Reconstruction caveat: FindTextIdsContaining and Tick are behaviour-certified (status/functions.json 0x14b0100, 0x14c96f0; BEHAV BG03); GetGameTextById/GetGameText are byte-matched. Content is partial; no exhaustive retail/Blueprint-only usage claim.

usages.detail: Rewrites STDM_SS_<n> script ids to the STDM_00... prefix used to find short-story dialogue rows.
Discovers message ids with FindTextIdsContaining using the rewritten prefix and stores them for the script.
Treats STDM_SS_* scripts as sub-stories and joins message ids to ShortStoryVoiceDataTable rows.
Resolves each displayed message id to its localized Text through GetGameTextById.
Loads ShortStoryDemoTextDataTable_<Language> into the shared GameText search array.
